Nano Banana is the preferred model for commercial work on Lovart. All assets generated by paid users come with a full commercial license, making it perfect for ads, packaging, and merchandise."},{"question":"Does Nano Banana support text rendering?","answer":"While Nano Banana excels at realism, for complex text layouts, we recommend using Lovart's 'Seedream' model or the built-in Text Edit tool, which can be orchestrated together on the same canvas."},{"question":"Is Nano Banana included in the free plan?","answer":"Users can try Nano Banana with daily free credits. However, heavy usage and access to the 'Pro' version (with faster generation and higher resolution) are optimized for our paid subscription tiers."}]}]
